message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7 -- 3 / 6b / 6r pick the host's pinned window, not the Desktop card

verify-0164 ran S and P at 7db9c27: both FAILed at 3. pick_desktop tapped the Desktop tab's first card (id 0); the
PinnedSelectTest host refuses every target but its one window by design (host_control_session.cpp:1699 ->
pinned_test_seam_refused), and 0.2.32 ended in select_failed pinned_test_only. A harness defect, not a product one.

oa_avd.py: pick_pinned replaces pick_desktop.
- the pinned id from the host's own log: the capture target's hwnd == the last window-list selectedId, count 1;
  otherwise FAIL and nothing is tapped
- the Windows tab (listWindowsButton), then the ONE targetCardTitle whose shown text (ellipsis cut) starts the
  window's title; the targets screen is kept as <OUT>/<n>_targets_ui.txt (the real UI's ids / text / bounds)
- judge_pick: PASS only if the app's first select_request is that id with tab=WINDOWS, the host's window-select
  applied=1 for it and none refused, and select_ready for that id; a frame after a request for id 0 is a FAIL
- verdict wording: "the pinned window picked" (3 / 6b / 6r). Gates, OFF, job, slot, adb: unchanged.
Selectors from b554e76 (0.2.32) source: activity_main.xml listWindowsButton / listDevicesButton, target_card.xml
targetCardTitle, MainActivity.kt:4513-4545 (Windows tab = the host's windows by title; Desktop = one card, id 0).
No device run in this change.

oa_pick_test.py 7/7 with stubs/fake_ui_adb (a fake 0.2.32 targets screen and both logs): the pinned card PASSes;
NEGATIVE the r6 path (Desktop card, id 0) FAILs in judge_pick, a Windows card sent as id 0 FAILs, id 0 applied
with a frame FAILs, no pinned card FAILs with no card tapped, capture/list disagreement FAILs with no tap.
Regressions: oa_pmclear_test 12/12, oa_adb_redact_test 7/7, oa_orchestration_test 22/22.
